'''Drift Hills Imperial Outpost''' was a military outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established on the border of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] and the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The bulk of the outpost was located underground in the northern edge of the [[Frigid Plain]] in the Icefall Plains, and the other entrance opened onto the [[Southern Snowdrift Hills]] on the Clabburn Tundra.
